Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not put my full name on it, but you can note that I was the driver of the vehicle.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the collision happened?
A: It was at an intersection in League City, Texas. I was going through on a green light.
Q: What were you doing just before the impact?
A: I was driving the speed limit, maybe a little under. I had my radio on low. Traffic was light.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the collision?
A: Not until the last second. It came in from my right side and I tried to brake, but it hit the passenger side of my car.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, and the airbags deployed on my side.
Q: Did you hit your head during the collision?
A: Yes, my head struck the window frame. I was dizzy right after and I still get headaches.
Q: Did you seek medical attention?
A: I was taken to an urgent care clinic that evening. They diagnosed a concussion and told me to rest from screens
and reading.
Q: Are you currently under any follow-up care?
A: I have a appointment scheduled with a neurologist, and I've been keeping a symptom journal.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I'm still haivng trouble concentrating at work, and I want the claim handled properly.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
</page>
